architecture.classification: Design decision / implementation conflict; not an authorization to weaken the ADR
architecture.text: 最终 Runtime 关闭后重新初始化必须另有能力声明和测试，不能默认支持。

evidence.fact: consume final physical receipt sets slot.retired=true
openRuntime ignores retired same-env slots and selects one for a fresh epoch
ordinary openRuntime/Runtime.close policy has no reopen capability declaration
slot reuse after receipt is allowed, but does not explicitly settle same-env post-final-close initialization policy

architecture.impact: Public facade can open a new Runtime after awaited final close under the ordinary profile; current documented first-slice initialization boundary and actual default admission differ. Historical mechanism reopen evidence does not itself approve a public-profile capability.
architecture.minimal_fix: Explicitly decide whether this first slice supports same-env final-close/reopen. If yes, declare supported routes/profile semantics and exact target cases; otherwise enforce the existing restriction in a separately authorized code task. Do not simply delete the ADR restriction to match code.

architecture.text: The eleven registry cases; companion v2 also says eleven registry/identity cases at lines 16-17

evidence.fact: current suite prints 12 registry checks passed, including stopped-subscription held-delivery poll case at 116-159

architecture.impact: Current README understates the registry suite and obscures the latest lifecycle regression coverage.
architecture.minimal_fix: Update the current README registry count to twelve or describe the covered assertions without a brittle count; leave historical reviews unchanged.

facts.fact: First complete slice says one Runtime initialization per env; final Runtime reopen requires separate capability declaration and tests.

Registry slot reuse after final receipt and failed-initialization rollback admission are permitted. This does not expressly authorize same-env new Runtime after successful final Runtime close; another env and failed-initialization recovery are distinct.
Policy pins ADR0013 bytes and declares calls, shared close owners and quotas; no same-env final Runtime reopen capability/limit found.
Closing an old Session prevents reuse of that Session, but openRuntime always creates a fresh Session and asks native.runtimeOpen; no per-env final-close restriction.

Final receipt consumption sets retired=true. openRuntime ignores retired same-env slot, selects free/retired slot and increments epoch, so fresh same-env public Runtime admission is reachable after ACK.
Explicit host-only return harness. Its repeated reservations follow initial handle-allocation failure, not successful final Runtime close, and cannot certify target support.

Real SDK26/API23 target evidence, but private completion-transport mechanism. same-env-reopen-refusal asserts rejection while old callback lease is entered/closing, then shutdown counters; not public final-profile capability approval. Scope explicitly excludes provider/worker/full C07.

Ordinary public HAR consumer opens exactly one Runtime. It proves a new Engine generation within that Runtime, then two idempotent runtime.close calls. It does not reopen Runtime after final close. C++/Rust reuse same consumer apart from HAR import; no exact final-candidate reopen acceptance identified.
Development companion scenarios and actual Worker exit, explicitly not final candidate/profile certification. No explicit final-Runtime-close/reopen support declaration found.

minimal_resolution: If this capability is intended, make an explicit route/profile capability decision, document same-env post-ACK admission and stale-object behavior, bind candidate target tests before certification.
If not intended, enforce existing first-slice restriction in a separately scoped implementation task.
Do not confuse Engine generation turnover, slot reuse across envs, failed initialization retry, or closing-before-ACK refusal with successful final Runtime close/reinitialization.

overall.judgment: 当前核心—适配器依赖方向和公共语义/宿主端口复用合理；所查实现接缝未发现需要重建核心、引入万能 runtime 或另起插件框架的问题。主要风险是设计承诺、配置能力、阶段验收和实际候选证据尚未全部闭合。

strengths.point: 按变化原因分层，保持领域值/规则/计划、wire DTO、IO 实现的边界，组合根装配具体实现；职责单元不强制成为物理包。
复用 ContractIR、ProjectPlan、TaskGraph 和 Source/Build/Candidate 事务；工具进程调度与 SDK 资源协议分离，提交权限留在 host，扩展和 verifier 不自授认证。
共同的是语义与符合性，不强制每个语言相同类层级。C/C++/Rust ArkTS 复用私有原生协议，Kotlin 保留受管注册器；route/provider/allocator/目标证据仍分别负责。
新 UI 样本是薄投影：复用既有订阅、停止请求和排水，不另建业务 owner 或 payload queue。Swift 的系统 Observation 和 ArkUI 独立入口控制默认依赖。
官方 Kotlin/CPF 构建根、版本、缓存和发布坐标分开；复用兼容源码不推导 KLIB/工具链兼容。稀疏 profile 与受影响范围验收优于全版本笛卡尔积。
扩展协议与初始化继续复用小端口、宿主事务、ProjectPlan/ContractIR 分工和 Wrapper；已有工程接入/升级是独立受检用例，不暗改 init 的职责。

obligation_boundary.meaning: Swift/ArkTS 必要能力按真实声明及所选 profile 适用；不要求纯函数套 Runtime/Engine，也不能用全部 Unsupported 逃避承诺能力。普通公开 API、错误、资源、线程、取消、数据等必要语义仍是完整交付前提。

obligation_boundary.level: 按配置选用的主线增强
obligation_boundary.meaning: 消费者可以关闭增强；项目已经承诺的配置仍须实现和逐配置验收，延期保持缺口，不能改称可不交付。关闭后应证明普通 API 可用、无无关依赖、额外订阅或 native owner。
NativeCoroutines 正式组合、KNOI、ANI、UniFFI-ArkTS 等按各自 X/profile 验证；源码、编译、旧后端认证或 UI 首片均不授予新路线运行/发布资格，也不反向成为全部主线工作的前置。

role_complexity.design_benefit: 真实声明/元数据是接口权威，只补无法推导的生命周期、线程和取消语义；生成业务 Facade，复用稳定手写 runtime。

role_complexity.optimization_without_new_framework: 优先完成一个有限 profile 的第二业务模块、改名及拒绝输入，用同一元数据生成 Facade/期望身份/接线；复用现有 IR 和 lowering，不追加手写平行 IDL 或公开句柄包装。

role_complexity.design_benefit: 普通 SDK 不要求 MadB/Gradle/Cargo/CPF；普通方法与资源对象是完整入口，可选 UI/宏依赖不进入基础 API；关闭页面观察不关闭共享引擎。
role_complexity.current_cost_or_gap: 显式 requestStop/close/drain 仍是必要生命周期成本。ArkTS 首片还需复制源码、没有 HAR 自动装配/registry profile；Swift SKIE integration 在默认 package target 外，UniFFI 投递适配未齐；正式安装候选与真实平台体验不能由宿主测试推导。
role_complexity.optimization_without_new_framework: 把现有三步生命周期写进每个受支持 profile 的可运行最短消费配方；在原 artifacts/templates/Lab 链完成安装包和生命周期接线，保持普通入口、关闭失败可观察且可重试。

role_complexity.design_benefit: 五类端口按需实现，复用受控进程、输出事务、SDK 语义与既有 EXT/CRIT/INIT/DX；清单与版本协商不要求复制整条工具链。
role_complexity.current_cost_or_gap: 当前 manifest v1 的 dependencies 只有 id/kind，完整版本/冲突/跨组件机制责任不是可执行字段；E01–E06 仍 not_started/missing。规范表格不是现行 CLI 可接受的 wire。
role_complexity.optimization_without_new_framework: 先显式支持少量允许组合。适配器私有配置继续走带 schema/版本/摘要的 backend_config；共同语义缺口按 E01/E03 演进并配共同格式向量，避免全局插件服务定位器或任意版本求解器。

role_complexity.design_benefit: 核心少量稳定包、具体工具留在外层、业务通用 runtime 与生成物分工、依赖按作用域/目标隔离，减少上游变更扩散。
role_complexity.current_cost_or_gap: 多层身份、取消完成点、平台变体及配置责任本来复杂，不能由同名类/包/哈希替代语义。E05/L03/L04 的整包阶段与平台依赖尚有待裁定边界；Runtime 同 env 关闭后重开也缺公开能力闭合。
role_complexity.optimization_without_new_framework: 每个 resolved profile 产出一次可检查的机制责任与依赖作用域信息，供生成、打包和验证复用；维护有限默认配置和明确升级流程。阶段/验收表直接复用现有 catalog，不另造任务平台。

role_complexity.design_benefit: 候选字节冻结、独立 Lab、公开消费者、目标与证据等级分离，能防止私有机制或编译成功被误读成完整认证。
role_complexity.current_cost_or_gap: 当前 C06 远端完整四路线证明、C07 最终四路线及 Kotlin 完整生命周期、L04/L05 实际平台/包消费仍未闭合；存在局部首片证据多而整包仍 missing 的真实状态。
role_complexity.optimization_without_new_framework: 按 candidate/profile/target/case 关联既有报告；局部探针保持局部标签，发布覆盖全部承诺配置，日常只裁剪已证明独立的受影响维度。新增业务公开消费者比增加镜像实现的单测更能证明通用性。
